state_rules.rule:
eq < system | ('counter' : N , ..) > < UserX | ('near' : deviceB , ...) > < deviceB | ('key' : Key , ....) > $ UserX 'pressButton' deviceB 
= < system | ('counter' : N + 1 , ..) > < UserX | ('near' : deviceB , ...) > < deviceB | ('key' : Key , ....) > $ deviceB 'sendMessage' UserX | (encrypt(randomStr('R', N), Key)) .

eq < UserX | ('storedMessage' : nils , ..) > $ deviceB 'sendMessage' UserX | (Message) 
= < UserX | ('storedMessage' : Message , ..) > .

eq < cloudA | (deviceB : ('key' : Key , 'owners' : (UserX , Rest) , ..) , ...) > $ UserX 'bindDevice' cloudA | (encrypt(R, Key)) 
= < cloudA | (deviceB : ('key' : Key , 'owners' : (UserX , Rest) , ..) , ...) > .

eq < cloudA | (deviceB : ('key' : Key , 'owners' : Owners , ..) , ...) > $ UserX 'bindDevice' cloudA | (encrypt(R, Key)) 
= < cloudA | (deviceB : ('key' : Key , 'owners' : (UserX , Owners) , ..) , ...) > .

eq < UserX | (..) > < cloudA | (deviceB : ('owners' : (UserX , Rest) , ...) , ....) > $ UserX 'resetDevice' cloudA 
= < UserX | (..) > < cloudA | (deviceB : ('owners' : (UserX , nils , ..) , ...) , ....) > .

eq < UserX | ('near' : nils , ..) > $ UserX 'approach' deviceB 
= < UserX | ('near' : deviceB , ..) > .

eq < UserX | ('near' : deviceB , ..) > $ UserX 'leave' deviceB 
= < UserX | ('near' : nils , ..) > .

event_rules.rule:
rl [rev4]: E @ S < UserX | ('storedMessage' : MessageA , ..) > 
=> ep: ev4(UserX, MessageA) @ S < UserX | ('storedMessage' : MessageA , ..) > .
